scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/frontend run build
scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres etcd minio milvus audio-service
scripts.infra:down: docker compose -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml stop postgres etcd minio milvus audio-service
